'''Firewisp''' is a horse, formerly belonging to a soldier in the [[Band of the Red Hand]]. Firewisp is now owned by [[Edesina Azzedin]].

==Activities==
When the [[Aes Sedai]] leave his camp, [[Mat Cauthon]] grudgingly parts with a number of horses, including Firewisp and [[Moonglow]].{{ref/book|13|17}}
